_about: Firmwares the FM-1 Flasher offers. Each entry is added only after checking the firmware's chip support and its SHA-256. 'file' is where the app expects it under firmware/ (not included in the repo). 'info_name' is how M-Flasher's info names it once installed. Per-unit state (each firmware's saved backup, favourites) lives in state.json, outside git.

firmwares.name: AMB-1
firmwares.chip: Supports the newer chip since 1.3.1 (issue #10 closed 2026-11-21).
firmwares.about: Generative ambient machine after Brian Eno's Music for Airports: breathing pads, bells on tape loops of different lengths, gliding bass, soft pulse, all through echo and reverb. Starts playing on power-on and never quite repeats.
firmwares.how:
MASTER: volume
PRESETS: one of eight pieces (try Tides, Shoreline, Departures)
ALGORITHM: the mode (Dorian, Lydian, pentatonic...)
Keys: lit keys are the scale; press to take a note out or put it back
EDIT: next chord   REC: freeze the chord   PLAY: rest / grow
HOME: Evolve, Motion, Drift (how much it changes)
SAVE: save now; hold 1.5 s to reset the piece
Hold any button 1 s for a help card
firmwares.usb: Yes (heard it here).

firmwares.name: AMB-1 Drift
firmwares.kind: Our AMB-1: new sounds, wanders between 24 pieces
firmwares.chip: Built here from AMB-1 1.3.2 (which supports the UC25HQ80) on the same fm1-base; the build of unchanged AMB-1 matched the official 1.3.2 byte for byte. Source: ../amb1-drift. USB name 'AMB-1 Drift FM-1'. Not yet run on the unit. 1.1 adds sounds: CPU estimated at most ~1.2x AMB-1's busiest piece (PC timing); check Setup's CPU% on the unit. 1.0 is still in firmware/amb-1-drift/1.0.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1 (heard it here on AMB-1).
firmwares.about: AMB-1 with Wander: on a setting, it glides from piece to piece by itself (levels and tempo slide, the key changes halfway on a new chord). New sounds: harp/kalimba strings, a strings pad, a bowed/glass lead, rain/wind/sea/vinyl air and reverb shimmer. 24 pieces: AMB-1's eight, Harbour Fog, Lantern, Snowfield, Moss, Late Train, Cathedral, Rain on Glass, Ember, and Monsoon, Lighthouse, Dust, Ridgeline, Aurora, Tea House, Low Tide, Orchard. Saved AMB-1 and Drift 1.0 settings carry over.
firmwares.how:
Everything works as AMB-1
GLO: Setup; GLO again: Wander
Wander page: KNOB 1 on/off, KNOB 2 every 2-60 min, KNOB 3 in order / shuffle, KNOB 4 glide (cut to 4 min)
ENV twice: Lead   ARP twice: Strings   FX twice: Air + shimmer
Pad page Colour: Rhodes / Voices / Strings
PRESETS: 24 pieces

firmwares.name: Tide Clock
firmwares.kind: Ambient day on a small coast
firmwares.chip: Built here on AMB-1 Drift (AMB-1 1.3.2, fm1-base 3ae2a65, which supports the UC25HQ80). USB name 'TIDE CLOCK FM-1'. Saves the world at most hourly (flash wear), settings at most every 5 min, SAVE at once. Not yet run on the unit.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1: stereo USB audio, no level setting; MASTER sets the level.
firmwares.about: The music follows the time of day on a little coast: sparse before dawn, full at midday, warm in the evening, dark drones at night. Tides, fog, wind and storms. Abel the lighthouse keeper, Captain the gull, three fishing boats. No clock on the FM-1: set the time at power-on, or Cycle mode (a day every 1-12 h).
firmwares.how:
Power-on: turn any knob to set the time, PLAY confirms
PLAY: rest / play   EDIT: set the clock again
HOME coast   SEQ log   GLO setup (Clock/Cycle, cycle length, sea, lights)
SAVE: save now

firmwares.name: Pond
firmwares.chip: Built here on AMB-1 Drift (AMB-1 1.3.2, fm1-base 3ae2a65, which supports the UC25HQ80). USB name 'POND FM-1'. Saves the world at most hourly (flash wear), settings at most every 5 min, SAVE at once. Not yet run on the unit.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1: stereo USB audio, no level setting; MASTER sets the level.
firmwares.about: A pond seen from above. Each fish has a name, species (its voice), temperament and a note; fish that meet play a chord. Fry, old age, seasons, frogs at night, a heron that scatters everything.
firmwares.how:
Keys: drop food (adds that note for a while)   ARP: food everywhere
PRESETS: follow a fish   ENV: its card   SEQ: journal
ALGORITHM: Busy   PLAY: rest   REC: freeze
FX: mix   GLO: setup, again: world
SAVE held 3 s: new pond

firmwares.name: Garden
firmwares.chip: Built here on AMB-1 Drift (AMB-1 1.3.2, fm1-base 3ae2a65, which supports the UC25HQ80). USB name 'GARDEN FM-1'. Saves the world at most hourly (flash wear), settings at most every 5 min, SAVE at once. Not yet run on the unit.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1: stereo USB audio, no level setting; MASTER sets the level.
firmwares.about: Keys plant melody seeds that sprout, grow into phrases, flower, seed their neighbours and wither into a fading drone. A gardener tends it; bees cross flowers into hybrids, a rabbit nibbles, rain and frost.
firmwares.how:
Keys: plant a seed at that pitch   ARP: random seed   EDIT: water all
Knobs: Tempo, Growth, Bells, Pad
PLAY: grow / rest   REC: freeze
ENV sound   GLO setup   SEQ ledger
SAVE held 3 s: new garden

firmwares.name: Night Train
firmwares.chip: Built here on AMB-1 Drift (AMB-1 1.3.2, fm1-base 3ae2a65, which supports the UC25HQ80). USB name 'NIGHT TRAIN FM-1'. Saves the world at most hourly (flash wear), settings at most every 5 min, SAVE at once. Not yet run on the unit.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1: stereo USB audio, no level setting; MASTER sets the level.
firmwares.about: An endless night journey through eight kinds of landscape, with generated stations. Wheel clacks follow the train's speed; chimes at stations. Passengers with stories: the conductor, a night nurse, a cellist, a man who won't say where he's going, an art student, Biscuit the cat.
firmwares.how:
HOME: K1 stretch length, K2 clack, K3 tone, K4 space
PRESETS right: skip to the next station
PLAY: stand / run   REC: freeze   EDIT: next chord   keys: bells
SEQ journal   ENV passengers   GLO setup

firmwares.name: Monastery
firmwares.chip: Built here on AMB-1 Drift (AMB-1 1.3.2, fm1-base 3ae2a65, which supports the UC25HQ80). USB name 'MONASTERY FM-1'. Saves the world at most hourly (flash wear), settings at most every 5 min, SAVE at once. Not yet run on the unit.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1: stereo USB audio, no level setting; MASTER sets the level.
firmwares.about: Seven monks chant over a drone in a stone chapel; a bell marks the eight offices, each with its own mode. The novice comes in early, old Ambrose sinks flat, two brothers clash over the pitch, one sleeps through Matins.
firmwares.how:
PLAY: rest / sing   EDIT: bell, next office now   REC: hold the note
OCT-/+: slower / faster chant   white keys: wake a brother or give him the verse
HOME chapel   ARP brothers   FX space   GLO setup (day length)

firmwares.name: Tavern
firmwares.chip: Built here on AMB-1 Drift (AMB-1 1.3.2, fm1-base 3ae2a65, which supports the UC25HQ80). USB name 'TAVERN FM-1'. Saves the world at most hourly (flash wear), settings at most every 5 min, SAVE at once. Not yet run on the unit.
firmwares.usb: Same as AMB-1: stereo USB audio, no level setting; MASTER sets the level.
firmwares.about: A late-night folk session: regulars wander in and play generated reels, jigs, waltzes and airs on fiddle, whistle, harp, accordion, bass and bodhran. Rivals, strangers, laments, broken strings, closing time.
firmwares.how:
PLAY: pause   REC: buy a round   EDIT: call for a tune
Keys: ask for the next tune's key
HOME, ENV, ARP, FX, LFO, GLO: pages (Room page K4: night length)
Knobs on pages without their own: Melody, Backing, Bodhran, Echo

firmwares.name: SHORTWAVE
firmwares.chip: Built against fm1-base 3ae2a65 and BSP f878800, which recognize the UC25HQ80 (0xB36014). The simulated updater preserved the bootloader and rejected a damaged image. Hardware compatibility is not yet verified.
firmwares.usb: Stereo USB audio input in Windows as SHORTWAVE FM-1. MASTER controls its level; the firmware has no PC audio playback endpoint.
firmwares.about: Four self-playing stereo ambient stations on a shortwave radio dial. It starts playing when powered on. Tune between stations to hear them overlap with soft static, or turn on scanning to move between stations automatically.
firmwares.how:
SELECT: tune   PRESETS: next station
HOME: center on the nearest station   SEQ: toggle scanning
PLAY: pause or resume
KNOB 1: noise   KNOB 2: motion   MASTER: volume (including USB)
SAVE: store tuning and mix settings

firmwares.name: NACHTFAHRT
firmwares.chip: Supports the newer chip since 1.0.1; a user with this chip confirmed 1.0.2 saves (issue #2, 2026-11-17).
firmwares.about: Generative 1970s Berlin School (Tangerine Dream, Klaus Schulze, Ashra): two drifting sequences over a drone, a lead improvising in the echo, optional rain or surf. Plays itself forever; you can join in on the keys.
firmwares.how:
MASTER: volume   PRESETS: one of ten pieces
Calm ones: Wahnfried, Sakura Rain, Umeda, Mirage. Busier: Phaedra, Rubycon
White keys: play the lead, always in key (a short phrase becomes its theme)
Black keys (hold): effects - Shimmer, Freeze, Octave, sweeps
PLAY: rest / resume
HOME: Filter, Evolve, Motion, Drift; again: tempo, key, mode
SEL: perform page; white 1-5 mute drone, sequence, lead, sequence 2, atmosphere
GLO held: save
firmwares.usb: Not yet confirmed here.

firmwares.name: Penumbra
firmwares.chip: 1.3 notes: the UC25HQ80 fix is in. Tested here: settings survive power-off.
firmwares.about: Ambient space-drone synth. A new unit plays TOTALITY, a self-running journey from first contact to afterglow; seven presets, a looper, drones on the black keys.
firmwares.how:
MASTER: volume (set SYSTEM > USB AUDIO to MASTER)
PRESETS: the presets (TOTALITY plays itself)
Black keys 1-5: drones
GLO: SYSTEM menu (USB AUDIO, SLEEP timer 20-90 min)
FX held: throws
firmwares.usb: Yes (heard it here); set USB AUDIO to MASTER.

firmwares.name: SLOOP
firmwares.chip: 2.8.5 fixed the newer chip. Open issues: faded LCD colours (#269), presets reset on restart (#255).
firmwares.about: Live four-track groovebox: three synths and a drum machine, twelve engines, 37 kits, song mode. Nothing plays until you play it.
firmwares.how:
ALGORITHM: pick track (4 = drums)   PRESETS: sound or kit
REC, play freely, REC on the next downbeat: the loop closes
REC again: overdub   EDIT + OCT-: undo
Hold FX + key: live effects   Hold GLO: mute / solo
Hold SAVE + key 5-8: save loop as section A-D
HOME menu > AUDIO > USB AUDIO: MASTER
firmwares.usb: Yes; HOME > AUDIO > USB AUDIO = MASTER.

firmwares.name: DUB-1
firmwares.chip: 1.4.4 (2026-11-23) says it now works on FM-1s with the newer flash chip; tested on one.
firmwares.usb: Not stated; it is an AMB-1 fork like NACHTFAHRT, so likely the same.
firmwares.about: Generative dub techno that plays itself: chord stabs through a resonant filter into tape echo, FM pings, sub bass, a ducking kick, vinyl crackle. Eight pieces. NACHTFAHRT was built from it.
firmwares.how:
PRESETS: one of eight pieces
PLAY: play / rest
SEL: arrangement; white keys 1-6 mute parts, black 1-5 solo
FX: dub page (echo, feedback, reverb)
GLO held: save

firmwares.name: AISLING
firmwares.chip: Accepts the newer chip since 0.5.1; 1.5 was tried on one newer unit; 1.6.1 itself not yet.
firmwares.usb: Yes, taken before MASTER (records at any volume; no MASTER-follow setting).
firmwares.about: Irish ambient drone: harps over a held drone, with flute, fiddle, chanter or voice leading in old modes. Eight pieces that play themselves (Skellig, Burren, Aran, Carolan, Blasket, Samhain, Connemara, Tir na nOg). Built on NACHTFAHRT.
firmwares.how:
MASTER: volume   PRESETS: the piece
White keys: play the lead
HOME: Filter, Evolve, Motion, Drift
SEL: perform page, 27 effects while held
GLO held: save (also autosaves a few seconds after a change)

firmwares.name: Melisma
firmwares.chip: Developed on one FM-1 with the newer chip (that unit had m-bootloader). Released today. WARNING: once installed it calls itself 'Melisma' over USB and M-Flasher (so this app) can't find it. Switching away from it is not yet sorted out here.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: A four-piece band you sit in with: bass, chords, melody and drums driven by word dials (7 moods, 5 energies, 12 styles). The keys only offer notes that fit. 64 pieces; a piece is a short code you can type in.
firmwares.how:
Dials: mood, energy, style, shape
Mute / solo parts on the bar line; eight scenes
A looping recorder with undo
Same settings always give the same music
Full manual: github.com/joelio/melisma-fm1

firmwares.name: Niagara Drift
firmwares.chip: Owner: the newer-chip problem was fixed in 0.2.1 (issue #66); 0.3.1 notes say tested on an older FM-1.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: Two virtual-analog drones that breathe and drift on their own, after the SOMA Lyra-8, Moog Subharmonicon and Stylophone DS-2. Not a melody instrument: you shape the drift.
firmwares.how:
16 presets on keys 1-8 of two banks; each moves over about a minute
HOME: the Drones page
Top keys held: gestures (Weight, Shift, Clean, Wash)
Keys 9-12 held: Tick, Chord, Snarl, Stutter

firmwares.name: MONK-1
firmwares.chip: 0.10: now works on the newer FM-1s (the UC25HQ80).
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: Twelve singing characters on a formant voice synth (Jerry the monk, Philip, Snider...), their mouths following the vowel on screen. You play it; good for slow choir-like lines.
firmwares.how:
PRESETS: the singer   ALGORITHM: the vowel
Pages: HOME Sing, EDIT Choir, LFO Vibrato, FX Echo, ENV Envelope, GLO Touch
Play harder for louder notes
SAVE: save now (also autosaves); hold 1.5 s to reset the singer

firmwares.name: FiMba-1
firmwares.chip: 0.7.0 (pre-release): works with the newer FM-1s.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: A physically modelled kalimba (thumb piano): tines in six materials, wooden bodies, a granular cloud, delay and reverb, and mbira patterns it can play by itself.
firmwares.how:
MASTER: volume   SELECT: tine material
ALGORITHM: scale   PRESETS: key
ARP tap: start / stop a self-playing pattern
PLAY: freeze the grain cloud   REC: palm mute
SAVE: save now (also autosaves)

firmwares.name: Tessera
firmwares.chip: Owner: recognises the chip since 3.3 (issue #646); a user saved fine on one with 3.5.3 (#744).
firmwares.usb: Yes: stereo in and out, or four tracks as stems.
firmwares.about: Composing through systems: 13 generators across four tracks that listen to each other, with song forms. ROLL finds a new piece, PLAY replays one exactly. Labelled experimental.
firmwares.how:
Each track: steps or one of 13 generators (SEQ > GEN)
ROLL: a new piece   PLAY: replay it
REC held: print a generator into steps
SAVE > PROJECT > slot > Save here

firmwares.name: Felucca
firmwares.chip: 1.8.2 and later recognise it (README).
firmwares.usb: Yes, as a USB audio input.
firmwares.about: The open-source base most other firmwares are built on: many synth engines including Mutable Instruments physical models, four tracks.
firmwares.how:
ALGORITHM: track   PRESETS: sound
Manual: github.com/hugelton/Felucca/wiki
There is a browser version to try first (webapp/try)

firmwares.name: OberVave
firmwares.chip: Takes the newer chip since 3.3.1 (README).
firmwares.usb: Unclear: issue #42 (Nov 14) says the PC stopped seeing it as an audio device. You might not hear it over USB.
firmwares.about: Late-70s Oberheim OB-X / OB-8 style: 8 voices over four tracks, 99 programs, mixer, effects, step sequencer. Featured in the video.
firmwares.how:
ALGORITHM: track A-D   PRESETS: program
HOME: PERFORM (cutoff, resonance, env amount, release); again: MIXER
SAVE: MEMORY page (8 slots). Nothing saves by itself

firmwares.name: B3 Organ
firmwares.chip: Tested on both chips, including the UC25HQ80 (README).
firmwares.usb: Yes, stereo USB audio.
firmwares.about: A tonewheel organ modelled on setBfree: 91 tonewheels, nine drawbars, key click, vibrato and chorus, percussion, overdrive, reverb and a Leslie. 110 programs.
firmwares.how:
KNOB 1: screen (upper, lower, pedal)
SELECT / ALGORITHM: drawbars
PRESETS: program
KNOB 2 vibrato, KNOB 3 overdrive, KNOB 4 reverb
LFO: Leslie stop / slow / fast

firmwares.name: FM-106
firmwares.chip: Automatic detection and support for the UC25HQ80 (README).
firmwares.usb: Yes, 44.1 kHz stereo.
firmwares.about: The Roland Juno-106: six voices, 256 presets, the BBD chorus, arpeggiator and a 128-step acid sequencer.
firmwares.how:
ALGORITHM: bank   PRESETS: preset
EDIT: steps through 11 pages; KNOB 1-4 are the faders
FX: chorus, tape, reverb
SAVE: save and name a patch

firmwares.name: Hortator
firmwares.chip: 1.0.1: recent FM-1s have a different flash chip and Hortator now recognises it.
firmwares.usb: Yes; master or eight tracks (MENU > USB AUDIO).
firmwares.about: 8-track drum machine: 808 and 909 models, Plaits-style drums, sample slicing, a Grids pattern generator, sends and effects.
firmwares.how:
PLAY: start   SEQ: white keys are the steps
ALGORITHM: track   PRESETS: sound
SAVE: projects A-D (last saved loads at power-on)
Hold HOME: menu

firmwares.name: fm1-dock
firmwares.chip: Accepts the newer chip since 0.8.1, but tested in the emulator, not yet on such a unit. Test release.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: One firmware, many synths: CS-1, Scintilla and OberVave built in; add AMB-1, DUB-1, Juno-106, MONK-1, B3, SID and more as modules from its web page without reflashing.
firmwares.how:
Hold HOME 1.5 s: the synth picker; PLAY loads
Add / remove modules: joakimeriksson.github.io/fm1-dock (Chrome or Edge)
OPTIONS (end of picker): EQ, effects, MIDI
Safe start: hold OCT+ while switching on

firmwares.name: MIN-1
firmwares.chip: README: MIN-1 knows the UC25HQ80 from 0.2.2. USB name 'MIN-1 FM-1'.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: A small minimalist ensemble after Philip Glass and 60s-80s minimalism: repeating figures, slow chord cycles, phasing. Twenty pieces in four models (Arpeggio, Phase, Patterns, Bells). Plays itself from power-on; inspired by AMB-1.
firmwares.how:
PRESETS: the piece (twenty)   ALGORITHM: chord cycle
White keys: a chord that fits (EASY mode); black keys add a seventh
PLAY: play / stop   EDIT: roll a new idea for this page
SEL held + page button: bring a part in or out
SAVE: save; hold any button 1 s for a help card
Try it first: reytian.github.io/fm1-min1/emu/

firmwares.name: ECHOFIELD
firmwares.chip: README: the newer chip is supported since 0.2.10. USB name 'ECHOFIELD FM-1'.
firmwares.usb: Yes, USB audio in (recordable over USB); no level setting stated.
firmwares.about: A granular sampler: a few seconds of sound become slow clouds, sparkles, tape loops and swells. Six modes (CLOUD, DUST, TAPE, BLOOM, PULSE, DRIFT), 14 factory sounds.
firmwares.how:
Keys: play the cloud at any pitch; chords work
Hold ENV: latch, so chords keep droning
Hold FX: black keys become freeze, reverse, shimmer, stutter...
ARP: random new settings (lock knobs you like)
After M-Flasher install it puts 8 starter sounds on by itself

firmwares.name: FRASIL
firmwares.chip: Newer-chip fix landed in 3.2 (earlier versions lost scenes at power-off). USB name 'FRASIL FM-1'.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: Drone textures frozen in motion: tap a key and a drone (note or chord) latches and slowly drifts in timbre into a big shimmer reverb. GLINT bells, a deep BASS and a LEAD on top. 16 scenes.
firmwares.how:
Tap a key: latch a drone (press harder: it swells)
GLINT: icy FM bells by hand, arpeggio or 32-step sequence
BASS: one deep note, an arpeggio or a line
LEAD: plays only while held
Scenes save to flash (16)

firmwares.name: Tuna
firmwares.chip: README: 'Patched for FM-1 units with the new chipset'; 1.1 notes say UC25HQ80 units now save. USB name 'Felucca'.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: Composes endlessly as it plays: pick one of 89 composers (Bach to Glass, Satie, Debussy) or 86 genres, or a character preset from STILL to DRIVE. Never the same twice; every piece has a share code.
firmwares.how:
Pick a composer, genre or character preset and let it play
OCT+: next piece (by manner, e.g. FUGUE 17/86)
Hold REC: favourite the piece
16 slots save the whole state
Cheat sheet: github.com/delirioux/tuna/blob/main/docs/CHEATSHEET.md

firmwares.name: Mutable Dreams
firmwares.chip: Author: both chip IDs accepted by app and updater. A newer-chip user confirmed save and reload on 2.0, not yet a power cycle; 2.4's own notes leave real newer-chip testing out of the claim. USB name 'Mutable Dreams FM-1'.
firmwares.usb: Yes, 8-channel USB audio; no level setting stated.
firmwares.about: A generative ambient garden on Mutable Instruments sound models: six tracks, 24 models, 664 tones, 25 self-playing 'Dreams' and 20 'Biomes' of evolving soundscapes.
firmwares.how:
Pick a Dream or Biome and let it grow
Any track can take any sound (Tones), keeping its notes
Hold a control for help text
Manual: kidbee85-beep.github.io/mutable-dreams (2.4 manual PDF)

firmwares.name: Tonitor
firmwares.chip: CHANGELOG Build 72: UC25HQ80 supported (saves and installs), but the author hasn't tested on such a unit. From the repo (no GitHub release), commit b1ffc18; SHA-256 matches the author's latest.json. USB name 'FM-1 Tonitor'.
firmwares.usb: Yes; AUDIO > USB = STEREO sends the master mix (as the headphones hear it).
firmwares.about: Dark ambient and electroacoustic sound objects: six tracks, each with its own engine (FM, a Lyra-8-style organism, Rings-style strings, West Coast, Oberheim SEM...) and its own free loop recorder. No tempo, no steps; textures, drones and gestures. Big, high-contrast screen.
firmwares.how:
Each track: pick an engine; new sounds lean AMBIENT, EXPERIMENTAL or OPEN
Play, layer and loop textures freely out of time
AUDIO > USB: STEREO
Manual: nzimas.github.io/tonitor/manual.html

firmwares.name: LOOM-8
firmwares.chip: 0.13 notes: LOOM-8 now works on the newer FM-1s (UC25HQ80): saves, backups and installing another firmware. USB name 'LOOM-8 FM-1'.
firmwares.usb: Not stated.
firmwares.about: Pocket groovebox by AMB-1's author: eight tracks on eleven engines (seven synths incl. a TB-303 acid, sample player, break slicer, drum kit), 97 presets, 64-step sequencer, 'weave' that crosses two patterns, a conductor track that moves the song through a progression, scenes and a song.
firmwares.how:
Ten-minute quick start in the manual: github.com/charlesvestal/fm1-loom/blob/main/docs/MANUAL.md
Try it first: charlesvestal.github.io/fm1-loom/emu/
Each track its own colour; throws = momentary effects
If it keeps crashing it starts in a safe mode
